subject: Scheduling: SOC 2 + Pen Test walkthrough for Ava Systems
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lemos <marta@avasystems.com>; Sam Ortiz <sam@avasystems.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-09-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: SOC 2 + Pen Test walkthrough — proposed windows

Hi Marta / Sam,

Thanks for confirming interest in a combined SOC 2 controls walkthrough and pen test intake. To keep this efficient for your ops and security teams, we usually run a 60–90 minute session that covers:
- SOC 2 scope & attestation artifacts (controls mapped)
- Evidence transfer and retention options (SFTP / signed DPA details)
- Pen test intake: scope, timing, vendor handoff, and temporary access controls

Can you confirm which of these windows work on your side (all times in PDT):
- Tue Sep 28 — 10:00–11:30
- Wed Sep 29 — 16:00–17:30
- Fri Oct 1 — 07:30–09:00 (early ops-friendly)

If none of those fit, send two proposals and we will mirror your timezone. I attached a short agenda and our SOC 2 summary to help decide which people to include.

Thanks,
Jordan
--
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0128

Attachments: Walkthrough_Agenda_v2.docx, Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf

From: Marta Lemos <marta@avasystems.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>; Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Ortiz <sam@avasystems.com>; itops@avasystems.com
Date: 2027-09-21T08:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 + Pen Test walkthrough — proposed windows

Hi Jordan,

Appreciate the agenda. Quick note on attendees: I'll bring our Head of Security (remote EU), Sam will pull in the pen test vendor contact, and our IT ops mailbox will be on the bridge for evidence transfer details. The early slot on Oct 1 is preferable for ops, but EU security prefers later in the day.

Two questions before we lock in:
1) Can you share the link to the doc with evidence mapping (SFTP vs. DocSend)?
2) Any required access windows for pen vendor (just read-only or temporary SSH)?

Proposed compromise:
- Thu Sep 30 — 13:00–14:30 PDT (this hits a late evening for EU; we can record)

If that works I'll get calendar invites out.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Lemos
Security Program Manager | Ava Systems
marta@avasystems.com

Subject: Re: SOC 2 + Pen Test walkthrough — proposed windows

Marta — thanks for the quick reply and the constraint callout. Answers inline below and a suggested compromise.

1) Evidence mapping link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c (read-only). We'll also accept SFTP keys or a one-time DocuSign receipt link for documented transfer.

2) Pen vendor access: typical pattern is temporary VPN + read-only S3 or time-boxed service user for < 48 hours. We can scope in the call; no permanent credentials required.

Compromise suggestion: Thu Sep 30, 13:00–14:30 PDT as you proposed. We'll set a Zoom and record. Agenda will include a 20-min pen intake checklist so vendor can triage followups asynchronously.

Laura / Ben / Priya — can you join for controls and evidence questions? If Ben can't make the 13:00 slot, we can flip to 15:00 and still keep EU coverage.

Jordan
--
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
